2 Petitioner apprehends arrest in a case registered for the offence punishable under sections 323,
341, 504, 506 and 498A of the Indian Penal Code sections 3 & 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.
3. Learned counsel appearing for the petitioner submits that both parties have resolved and settled their dispute in terms of settlement mutually agreed upon by them.
A copy of the settlement is annexed with the mediator's report dated 30.8.2025.
4. Learned counsel for opposite party no.2 does not controvert the submission of the learned counsel for the petitioner.
5. Considering the mediator's report, prayer for bail of Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.20227 of 2025(5) dt.08-10-2025 the petitioner is allowed.

In the event of arrest/surrender within six weeks from today, let the petitioner, mentioned above, be enlarged on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.10,000/- (ten thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the Sub Meraj Ahmad vs The State Of Bihar on 8 October, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/20923316/
